// === Tab: mySketch ===
let offsetFills
let offsetStrokes

let rectModel
let circleModel

let cam
let grain

function setup() {
	createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);
	setAttributes({ antialias: true })
	offsetFills = baseMaterialShader().modify(offset)
	offsetStrokes = baseStrokeShader().modify(offset)

	cam = createCamera()
	cam.ortho()
	setCamera(cam)

	rectModel = buildGeometry(() => {
		rectMode(CENTER)
		rect(0, 0, 100, 100)
	})
	circleModel = buildGeometry(() => {
		ellipse(0, 0, Math.hypot(100, 100), Math.hypot(100, 100), 50)
	})

	grain = baseFilterShader().modify(() => {
		getColor((inputs, canvasContent) => {
			const n = noise(inputs.texCoord * inputs.canvasSize) * 0.1
			return getTexture(canvasContent, inputs.texCoord) + [n, n, n, 0] 
		})
	})
}

function offset() {
	const seed = uniformFloat()
	const scale = uniformFloat()
	getWorldInputs((inputs) => {
		const id = instanceID()
		noiseDetail(1, 1)
		let dx = round(5 * noise(seed, id, 0)) * scale
		let dy = round(5 * noise(seed, id, 1)) * scale
		let dz = id
		inputs.position += [dx, dy, dz]
		return inputs
	})
}

function applyOffset(seed, scale) {
	shader(offsetFills)
	strokeShader(offsetStrokes)
	for (const s of [offsetFills, offsetStrokes]) {
		s.setUniform('seed', seed)
		s.setUniform('scale', scale)
	}
}

function draw() {
	background('#E6E4D5')
	orbitControl()
	strokeWeight(2)

	const t = millis()
	var seed = floor(t / 4000) + map(t % 4000, 3000, 4000, 0, 1, true)

	const h = 100 * sqrt(2)

	cam.camera(
		((window.simulatedMouseX !== undefined ? window.simulatedMouseX : (typeof sub_bass !== 'undefined' ? map(sub_bass, 0, 1, width*0.1, width*0.9) : (typeof live_centroid !== 'undefined' ? map(live_centroid, 100, 4000, 0, width) : mouseX))) - width/2) * 0.5,
		((window.simulatedMouseY !== undefined ? window.simulatedMouseY : (typeof percussive !== 'undefined' ? map(percussive, 0, 1, height, 0) : (typeof roughness !== 'undefined' ? map(roughness, 0, 1, height*0.2, height*0.8) : mouseY))) - height/2) * 0.5,
		800,
		0,
		0,
		0
	)
	// setCamera(cam)

	push()
	translate(0, 0, -50)
	rotate(PI/4)
	fill('#111')
	scale(3)
	applyOffset(seed+0, h*2)
	model(circleModel, 5)
	pop()

	push()
	translate(0, 0, -150)
	rotate(PI/4)
	fill(100, 100, 150, 220)
	applyOffset(seed+0.5, h)
	model(circleModel, 5)
	pop()

	push()
	rotate(PI/4)
	scale(2)
	noFill()
	applyOffset(seed+1.5, h)
	model(rectModel, 10)
	pop()

	push()
	rotate(PI/4)
	scale(2)
	fill(255, 0, 0, 150)
	applyOffset(seed+0.75, h)
	model(rectModel, 10)
	pop()

	push()
	rotate(PI/4)
	fill('red')
	applyOffset(seed+1, h)
	model(rectModel, 10)
	pop()
	
	push()
	translate(0, 0, 50)
	rotate(PI/4)
	fill(0, 0, 0, 50)
	applyOffset(seed+2, h/2)
	model(rectModel, 20)
	pop()

	push()
	translate(0, 0, 150)
	rotate(PI/4)
	scale(3)
	fill(0, 0, 0, 50)
	applyOffset(seed+3, 2*h)
	model(rectModel, 4)
	pop()

	filter(grain)
}
